svg.title: Three original thirty-sixty-ninety triangle unknown-side exercises
svg.desc: Three similar right triangles are shown independently, not to a shared real-world scale. Triangle I has short leg 4 units and hypotenuse 8 units; its long leg is unknown. Triangle II has short leg 6 units; its long leg and hypotenuse are unknown. Triangle III has long leg 5 square root three; its short leg and hypotenuse are unknown. Every triangle has 30, 60 and 90 degree angles. All five unknowns must be justified using similarity and the Pythagorean theorem.
svg.text: Five unknown sides across three 30°–60°–90° triangles
Original problems. Each triangle has its own scale; identify short, long and hypotenuse.

g.text: Five lengths are unknown. Use angle correspondence and Pythagoras to justify each answer.
